title: Polygon-Circle Relations
description: Two mirrored pairs of constructions: inscribe a circle in a triangle, then circumscribe one about it; superscribe a regular polygon (square, hexagon, octagon, or 12-gon) about a given circle, then inscribe a regular polygon (any n from 5 to 9) inside one — animated step by step, then set up as a textbook problem to verify.
